newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Atlantis plans public offering in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Atlantis plans public offering in 1997.

text.p: Polish construction materials producer Atlantis SA plans to offer between three and five million shares for public trade this year, an official of the bank advising on the issue said on Thursday.

"The company (Atlantis) plans to issue between three and five million shares, series D, which will be subject to a public offer this year," Krzysztof Sobolewski, from MC Concordia investment bank, told Reuters.
He said Atlantis -- controlled by Waldemar Obrebski, a private investor -- was seeking a main market listing.
According to preliminary data, Atlantis netted 2.3 million zlotys last year on sales of 23.9 zlotys.
